llm_response.reason: The website makes unrealistic guarantees of extremely high returns (up to 80% ROI), uses manipulative psychological language targeting novice investors, presents unverifiable and generic testimonials of large, instant withdrawals, and promotes referral programs—a frequent tactic in Ponzi and scam sites. The privacy and company details are ambiguous, and the domain was registered less than six months ago despite claims of over 10 years of business. There are no signs of regulatory oversight, and many scam criteria (2, 3, 11, 12, 13, 15) are clearly present.
